summary: Apply ISO 21502 project management guidance and prepare for the PECB Lead Project Manager exam with practical examples and quizzes.
audienceIntro: This course is for people responsible for managing project work, providing project direction, advising project teams, or contributing to project governance and audits. This course is designed for: Project managers coordinating project initiation, planning, delivery, control, and closure. Project sponsors providing direction and overseeing project governance decisions. Expert advisers supporting the application of ISO 21502 project management guidance. Project team members carrying out activities within an ISO 21502 project. Executives, managers, and directors governing, directing, or auditing projects.
prerequisites: A fundamental understanding of project management concepts, methodologies, and practices is required to participate in this course.
